test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully and decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

If Ritu studies effectively for 6 h daily from today, she will be able to pass the exam which is due after 10 days.

**Courses of Action:**

(i) Ritu must effectively study science for 6 h daily for 10 days to be able to prepare enough to pass her exam.

(ii) Ritu must plan her time ahead of preparation and give sufficient time to every subject.

(iii) Ritu must not play during these 10 days which are crucial for her for preparation for exams.
solution:
Given:

**Statement**: If Ritu studies effectively for 6 h daily from today, she will be able to pass the exam which is due after 10 days.

**Course of Action:**

I. Ritu must effectively study science for 6 h daily for 10 days to be able to prepare enough to pass her exam - **False** (Because the statement does not specify that she needs to study only science for 6 hours daily. It could be any subject.)

II. Ritu must plan her time ahead of preparation and give sufficient time to every subject - **True** (Because effective studying often involves planning and allocating time to different subjects.)

III. Ritu must not play during these 10 days which are crucial for her for preparation for exams - **False** (Because the statement does not mention that she should completely avoid playing; balance and breaks are important for effective studying.)

So, **Only II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
